title: Museum-grade quality and incredible pile depth
comment: We ordered the 200x300cm Arc rug for our main living room in Kacyiru. The density of the New Zealand wool and the subtle hand-carved relief between the cream ground and golden arc are sensational underfoot.
admin_reply: Thank you so much Aline! It was an absolute pleasure tufting the custom golden arc for your living space. – Rug Mosaic Atelier

title: Rich crimson tone and durable heavy backing
comment: The deep burgundy hues match the lighting in our study perfectly. The natural latex backing holds firmly on our hardwood floor without sliding at all. Outstanding local craftsmanship.
admin_reply: Warm regards David, we are thrilled it anchors your study so handsomely!

title: Artisanal textile mastery — tracked every stage!
comment: Being able to watch our rug progress through the tufting, carving, and backing stages made the wait genuinely exciting. The final piece is a centerpiece in our home.

title: Exceeded all expectations
comment: Soft, luxurious, and heavy. Everyone who walks into the apartment immediately bends down to touch the wool. 10/10.
